item.title: Ghostline 1.1 (279)
item.description:
The Circle now shows whether a friend is in your chat, at Veil, or at Séance, with clearer Mac and iPhone indicators when both devices are active. Your ghosts keep their gentle floating motion and their places as conversations change.

Right-click a ghost to wave, open chat, or jump into an available game. Waves appear quietly inside chats and games too, with a wave-back action. Recent comebacks, lead changes, and broken streaks can add a small flourish to the Circle, with an explanation in the ghost’s menu.

Also includes the mailbox recovery fix for a “Catching up” indicator that could remain visible after games moved to the newer service.

For the new quiet wave experience, both people should update their apps. Earlier versions handle waves as the existing knock gesture.
